# Contribution templates

Start with the smallest template that describes the change:

- [Feature spec](spec.md): problem, scope, existing test interface and acceptance evidence.
- [Detector change](detector-change.md): synthetic fixture and category comparisons.
- [Agent adapter](adapter.md): paths, protocol semantics, restoration and real-agent evidence.
- [UX scenario](ux-scenario.md): user comprehension, state and recovery behavior.
- [Release record](release.md): exact source/artifact identities, checks, limits and review.

Use the concise format in [ADR 0001](../adr/0001-claude-first-local-core.md) for durable decisions rather than filling out a large form. GitHub issue/PR templates are in `.github/` for future use; work items remain local until publication is requested.
